remarks: The single most important source for this license - the Haryana Labour Department's own site (hrylabour.gov.in), which administers Factory License grant/renewal under the Factories Act 1948 - was unreachable all session (TLS connection reset by peer on every attempt, verified with verbose diagnostics). This significantly limits what could be verified first-hand; the verified list below relies on adjacent official Haryana Government channels (Industries & Commerce department, the state government's main portal/SARAL/e-Gazette pages, and the central NSWS portal) rather than the Labour Department's own checklist/portal pages.

investharyana.in (the Haryana single-window/HEPC portal commonly cited for factory registration) returned HTTP 200 but is a pure Angular single-page app with no server-rendered content reachable via curl, so it could not be verified as a real content source despite clearly being a live, operating site.

haryanaindustries.gov.in uses a CMS where only the root '/' path returns HTTP 200; every deeper path tested (including '/services', which contains a genuine FAQ on Factories Act registration/license procedure, and '/acts-rules') returns HTTP 404 from the server itself even though it serves a large, real HTML body. Per the spec's requirement of HTTP 200 (not 403/404), these were excluded rather than included, even though their content looked genuine and directly relevant.

A Haryana Government Gazette PDF (Right to Service Act notification dated 14 Nov 2022, published on haryanaindustries.gov.in) was fetched and read in full (8 pages, confirmed real gazette content with state emblem, Chief Secretary signature, and a service/timeline schedule) but was excluded from verifiedSources entirely rather than included or logged as a verification failure, because on inspection its schedule covers only Industries & Commerce Department services (Boiler Act, Partnership Act, Societies Act, Lubricating Oils licensing) and does not include the Factories Act/Factory License at all - it is a real, reachable, but topically irrelevant document for FAL.

services.india.gov.in and saralwww.haryana.gov.in were both rejected by the egress proxy with a 502 connect_rejected, which the proxy's own documentation describes as either a policy denial or an upstream failure - this session could not determine which.

No candidate 'Haryana Factories Rules' PDF (state-specific rules text or gazette notification) could even be located as a direct .gov.in link via search; secondary sources indicate Haryana largely follows the Punjab Factories Rules 1952 as amended for Haryana, with amendments themselves only found on non-government legal-archive sites (PRS India, Indiacode is official but timed out), so no Factories Rules text source is included here.
